headlines: Premarket 09:07 ET: SPY 755.00 (-0.63%) on Stocktwits; Stocklake delayed SPY 754.76 (-0.66%), QQQ -1.14%, IWM -0.50%, GLD -1.94%, TLT -0.52%

rumors.text: Overnight analyst moves: William Blair downgrade, Citi PT 225, Stifel 205, Bernstein 400 to 200, Ives values NVDA 225 without Huang vs 300 with him
